name: New Frontiers
summary: Race for the Galaxy board game of building a galactic empire with technologies, worlds, goods and action selection.
rules_text: Each player has an empire mat with colonists, credits, developments and worlds. Supply of VPs (12 per player) and colonists. Worlds are in a bag. Each round players in priority order select one unused action tile (2 each in 2p). All players in priority order resolve that action, selector gets bonus. Actions: Retreat - no action, +2 credits; Develop - buy one development paying credit cost minus powers/bonus; Explore - draw worlds; Settle - pay colonists to place a world from hand; Produce - place goods on production worlds; Trade-Consume - trade goods for credits or VPs; Envoys/Goals - manipulate priority. Powers on developments/worlds modify specific actions after placement. Game ends after round when VP pool empty, a player exceeds 10 development spaces, or other pile thresholds are hit, then final scoring of VPs, chips and tile points wins.
rating_reason: Empire building tableau no board, strategic role selection fits engine.
reasons: scope: spatial_board: out of scope by decision: the game depends on a spatial board (a grid, map, movement or adjacency)
